text.jp:
ちょっと前に知り合った猟師の爺にな。
肉が食いたきゃ来いって猟を手伝わされたんだ。
text.official_en:
An old hunter a while back told me he had meat to
share. Then he put me to work helping him hunt!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダイトウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
腰痛めたんならそう言えばいいのにな。
素直じゃねえ奴だぞ。
text.official_en:
If he needed help, he shoulda just come out and said
so. No need to protect your pride, buddy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダイトウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でもおかげで美味い肉が食えたぞ！
誰かと一緒に狩りってのもいいもんだな！
text.official_en:
Still, it was some tasty meat! And it's always nice
to go hunting with someone else!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
そのままのテフって苦いから、
ちょっと好きになれないや。
text.official_en:
Plain coffee is so bitter! I can't even pretend to make
myself like it.
text.real_en:
Plain tef is so bitter! I can't even pretend to make
myself like it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
牛乳と蜂蜜をたーっぷり入れて、甘いお菓子と
食べるのはいいんだけど……我儘かな、もしかして。
text.official_en:
I do like it with milk and honey though. And I love a
cup with a sweet snack. Is that maybe too indulgent?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グザラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
随分前にダンテが取材に来たことがあった。
おれの活躍を事細かに話してやったんだが……
text.official_en:
Dante came to me looking for story ideas, so I
shared many a Guzran escapade!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グザラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
『話が飛躍し過ぎだ！　幼子の言い訳よりも
支離滅裂だぞ！』と怒鳴られたぜ。
text.official_en:
She threw up her hands and walked off, saying that
I defied belief. That children made more sense!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グザラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やれやれ。信じられないような偉業を
成し遂げちまうのがこのおれだってのに。
text.official_en:
What a reaction! I mean, I was there for each of
these epic feats! Every detail, lived by ME!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
旅の喜びの一つは、
その土地でしか飲めぬ酒にありつけることよな。
text.official_en:
One of the joys of travel is finding yourself in the
proximity of truly local tipple!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
南方で飲んだ葡萄酒も、北部で飲んだ熟成蜂蜜酒も
まさしく甘露のようであった……
text.official_en:
The wine of the south... The aged mead in the
north... Nectars by different names!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それがしは各地を放浪している故、
そこらの酒好きとは経験が違うのだ。
text.official_en:
My wandering has bobbed and weaved all over the
continent. I have many tales of drink and revelry!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ネイサンさんもキリークさんも
相変わらずの強さだったな。
text.official_en:
Nathan and Creek lived up to their reputation in
that recent match, that's for sure!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが、なぜ彼らは執拗にオルヘルの仮面を
狙ったんだ？　効果的な戦術とも思えないが。
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あの二人は無駄なことをするような方ではない……
ならば、誰かに指示されたのか……？
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
朕が来た頃より神殿兵が増えているな。
治安の維持に難儀しているらしい。
text.official_en:
We perceive more temple soldiers here. Are they
having difficulty keeping the peace of late?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ペペ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
祭りの陰に、盗人、刃傷沙汰……これもまた、
巨大な都市の一側面か。教訓とせねばなるまい。
text.official_en:
Thieves in the shadows? Bloody treachery in the
dark? Perhaps it's in the nature of vast cities.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
おれなりに、都会っぽくしてるのに、
何か違うんだよね……
text.official_en:
I'm trying to learn the ways of city life, but I'm
finding it harder than ever.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
街中で都会の人たちに聞いても、
好きにするのが一番としか言われないし……
text.official_en:
When I ask people, they just tell me I can do
pretty much...as I please.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ノクチュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ううーん……
都会って、何だ？？
text.official_en: Ugggh. What even is a city?!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ソレルさまの像っていつ見ても立派よね。
もちろん、実物のほうがもっと素敵なのだけど！
text.official_en:
Lord Solel's statue is grand as it gets! Of course,
the actual Solel is a lot more extra-grand!
text.real_en:
Lord Sorell's statue is grand as it gets! Of course,
the actual Sorell is a lot more extra-grand!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こう……内面の優しさが光り輝いて
見えるような素晴らしさというか……
text.official_en:
The wonderful sight of him is like a window into
his inner kindness. Or something like that!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ソフィア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ソレルさまにお会いしたことのある人なら、
きっとわかってくれるはずよ！
text.official_en: Anyone who's met him would get it!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
“アラゴの双璧”……二つ名は立派だけど、
仕えている王は酷い噂ばかりなのよね……
text.official_en:
The Twin Jewels of Arago live up to their name, but
rumors about their king swirl with ugliness.
text.real_en:
Arago's Twin Pillars live up to their name, but
rumors about their king swirl with ugliness.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
仕えるべきだと思って仕えているのなら、
理解できないし……
text.official_en:
Do they serve such a man because they feel they
must? Then I have their measure wrong.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
仕えるべきではないと思って仕えているのなら、
まったく理解できないわね。
text.official_en:
And if they don't grasp the situation at all, then
they're not even worth measuring.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大剣闘祭に合わせて、帝都にも店が増えた。
肉料理の屋台にはたいして魅力を感じないが……
text.official_en:
The Heroic Games have brought a lot more shops
to the capital, and food stalls too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
甘味の店も増えたのはいいな。
良質な蜂蜜やデーツを使い、趣向を凝らした菓子……
text.official_en:
I don't care much for the meat dishes. I prefer the 
sweets, like those made with honey and dates.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
閉会した後には辞めてしまう店も多そうだが、
どうにか続けてほしいものだ。
text.official_en:
I bet many of these shops and stalls will close after
the games end. But hopefully not.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
美味そうな野菜を売ってる奴がいやがった。
よだれが止まらねえぜ。
text.official_en:
I spotted some guy with some veggies. Good stuff!
Can't stop drooling over 'em.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
襲って奪っちまえば、値段なんて関係ねえ。
あいつが一人になるのを待って……ひひっ。
text.official_en:
Heh heh! And maybe if he finds himself alone...
he'll find he wants to just fork it all over!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝都の奴ら、どいつもこいつも
いい飯食ってるに違いねえぜ。
text.official_en:
Damn these people! Who do they think they ARE,
feasting like they're champions or something?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
何せ、牢でちょろちょろしてる鼠すら、
ぶくぶく太ってて美味いもんな。
text.official_en:
Even the rats in the prison are gettin' plump.
Tasty too.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
実にくだらん！　仮面の下が、
美女だろうが何だろうが、どうでも良かろうが！
text.official_en:
Masks and ladies! Ladies and masks! Who cares?!
But it's the talk of the city lately. What swine!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
「ハスドルバル戦記」に名高き
アラゴの騎士たちの戦いが見られたのだぞ？
text.official_en:
We saw a rare match, as if those knights stepped
off the pages of the War Chronicle of Hasdrubal!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
婦女子の美醜の話ばかりしおって、
情けない者ばかりだわい！
text.official_en:
All this prattling about how women look, or don't
look—it's pathetic and pointless!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
はあ……
ミトラス修道会のせいで災難ばかり……
text.official_en:
There'll be nothing but disasters in store, thanks
to the Order of Mithras.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ウゴウの弓と引き換えに
家族や仲間がくれたお金もすべて取られるし……
text.official_en:
They swindled me out of the money my family and
friends lent me—all for Ugo's Bow.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
払った分、稼ぎ直さないと故郷に帰れないわ……
また傭兵にでもなるしかないわね……
text.official_en:
I can't go back to my people until I earn it back.
And that means mercenary work...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
キリーク様が、女の子相手に
まさかあんな真似をするとはねえ……
text.official_en:
I can't get my head around noble Creek treating
his opponent like that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あたしがアラゴにいた頃は、
紳士的で素敵な方だって有名だったのに。
text.official_en:
When I was in Arago, he was considered the
most wonderful fellow—a real gentleman.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
少し前にエスメラルダさんと
ディートリヒさんの話で盛り上がったのですが……
text.official_en:
I was having the nicest time chatting with
Esmeralda about her "Sweetie" a short while ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
優しくて素敵な方ですよね、と言った途端、
嬉しそうな怒ったような顔をされてしまい……
text.official_en:
Then I said he seemed like a kind, great person. She
gave me such an angry look! Yet...happy too?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
『負けないからなー！』と叫び、そのまま去って
しまったんです。仲良くなれると思ったのに……
text.official_en:
Then she stormed off and shouted, "I won't lose
to you!" I thought we were friends!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アウロラ神殿のバルカンは皆、
大剣闘祭の円滑な運営に奉仕しているが……
text.official_en:
The vulkans in Aurora's temple are supporting the
smooth operation of the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
他の神殿の場合、多くは独自に動いているようだ。
出場者となる者も、姿を見せぬ者もいる……
text.official_en:
However, other temples' vulkans are doing otherwise.
Some enter the contest, others hide their faces.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……考えても詮無きことか。そもバルカンは、
神位直属の戦力。すべては神々のご意向次第だ。
text.official_en:
It's unavoidable, I suppose. Vulkans are subordinate
to the divine. They do what the gods ask of them.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
くそっ。あいつ、昔は俺に媚びへつらってた癖に
急に態度を変えやがって！
text.official_en:
Damn! I saw someone who used to beg for a shot at
workin' for me. Now he's treatin' me all different...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
他の連中も、お宝も金もねえと知ったら
冷たくするんだろうな……
text.official_en:
All my guys are gonna give me the cold shoulder
once they find out I've lost my whole treasure...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
腹立つぜ……
いつか、絶対に後悔させてやる……！
text.official_en: I'll make 'em regret it! Every last one of 'em!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
われは一つの役目を終えた……
ならばまた、一人のハル・ハリの戦士に戻るのみ。
text.official_en:
I have seen my duty through to the end. Now I
return to being a simple Har Hali warrior.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
力をつけねばならぬ。
バーン・バーンの過ちをくり返さぬためにも……
text.official_en:
I must grow in wisdom so as not to repeat the
mistakes of Bahr Vahn.
text.real_en:
I must grow in wisdom so as not to repeat the
mistakes of Baan-Baan.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガブリエル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……どんだけ時間が経とうが、
思い出したくない過去ってやつはあるものさ。
text.official_en:
There are some things you hate remembering,
no matter how much time goes by.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガブリエル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
当然、ワシのような年寄りともなると、
そんなのは一つや二つじゃねえ。
text.official_en:
And when you're an old man like me, you get to
have a lotta stuff like that piled up.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガブリエル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが、よりによって……なんであんな男が
今更ここに舞い戻ってきやがったんだ……
text.official_en:
But c'mon... Why'd he have to reappear here? Now?
Of all times?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この私も、この街の者達から
存在を忘れられて久しい……
text.official_en: The people of this city have long forgotten me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
名前も……所業も……
すべて忘れ去られていくばかり、か……
text.official_en: My name... My deeds... All has faded into oblivion.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
さすがはダグシオン大剣闘祭……
俺達のまだ知らぬ強者も多くいるようだ。
text.official_en:
I'm surprised the games reeled in so many warriors
I'd never even heard of.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザ中から凄腕が集まったという話、
伊達ではないらしい……
text.official_en:
I don't think it would be an exaggeration to call this a
historic gathering of Dagda's best.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
先月だけで随分と負けたものだ。
こうなると、逆に可笑しくなってくるな。
text.official_en:
Defeat after defeat last month! You almost have
to laugh.

text.jp:
これでは、アラゴの双璧の値打ちも
随分と下がってしまったに違いない。
text.official_en:
The sheen's really come off the Twin Jewels
of Arago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やれやれ……こんな事では、
あいつに合わす顔がないな……
text.official_en: I wouldn't be very proud to face my sister like this.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミワイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神々の楽園、白き谷ザナド……
楽園が人を食らう……
text.official_en:
Paradise... White Canyon Zanado... It eats people.
Swallows them in an instant.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミワイ

text.jp:
だが、誰一人として
儂の言うことなぞ信じちゃくれん……
text.official_en: But nobody ever believes the things I say...

text.jp:
なあ……
あんたは信じてくれるか？
text.official_en: Do you believe what I'm telling you?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
“アラゴの双璧”を見られて興奮したよ！
赤と緑の二人組！　かっこいいよなー！
text.official_en:
I got to see the Twin Jewels of Arago. It was all I
hoped for! The red-and-green team is unbeatable.
text.real_en:
I got to see Arago's Twin Pillars. It was all I
hoped for! The red-and-green team is unbeatable.

text.jp:
僕も相棒を見つけて、あんなふうになりたい！
今は弟で我慢かなー？
text.official_en:
I should find a buddy and practice to be just like
them. Maybe my brother would be up for it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
警備の合間につまむ軽食は、
やっぱり果物がいいかな。
text.official_en:
Fruit makes for a pretty good snack to grab in
between security shifts.

text.jp:
同僚に分けるのも考えると、キンバショウ１房か、
ギンジの袋詰めか、迷う……
text.official_en:
I might grab a bunch of jin ba jiao or a bag of ginji
fruit to share with my comrades in arms.

text.jp:
ああ、テフノミの果醤を塗った菓子もいいか……
いかんな、仕事がそっちのけになってしまう。
text.official_en:
Though some sweets coated with coffee-berry paste
would be good too... Wait, no, I'm distracting myself.
text.real_en:
Though some sweets coated with tef-berry paste
would be good too... Wait, no, I'm distracting myself.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
酒場なんかで、地元の名産品を使った料理を
見つけると、ちょっといい気分になるね。
text.official_en:
It's always nice to find dishes made with ingredients
from my homeland in a tavern here.

text.jp:
村のみんなで頑張って作った野菜が、
美味しく食べられてるって思うとさ。
text.official_en:
I like seeing the vegetables my people work hard
to grow being enjoyed by others.

text.jp:
帰ったら、帝都で人気だったって
教えてあげるとしようかね。
text.official_en:
When I'm back home, I'll tell them all how much they
loved it in the capital.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
例の神官様、美人も美人で苦労があるんだろうね。
あんな仮面を着けなきゃいけなかったなんて。
text.official_en:
Beauty must be its own trouble. I heard of a gorgeous
priest who hid herself away behind a mask.

text.jp:
いろんな人に言い寄られたりとかで
大変なのかな……？
text.official_en:
They say she could no longer bear the constant
attention and flattery.

text.jp:
うーん……羨ましいような、
羨ましくないような……
text.official_en: Hmmm... I envy her, yet in some ways I don't.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
恨んでやるぞ、キリークとやら……
孫娘があの人と結婚するとか言い始めた……
text.official_en:
I can't abide that Creek! My granddaughter has
started saying she's going to marry him.

text.jp:
まだ５歳だぞ！？　そんなものまだ早い！
ううん……連れて行くんじゃなかった……
text.official_en:
She's scarcely five years old! Much too young to
think of such things. Ahh, why did I take her along?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
掃除、水汲み、掃除、写本作り、掃除……
やることが多くて大変！
text.official_en:
Cleaning, water carrying, more cleaning, manuscript
copying, even more cleaning... I'm at my wit's end!

text.jp:
でも、こういう苦労が信仰の力になるのよね。
明日も頑張ってお勤めするわよ！
text.official_en:
But heavy burdens make for strong faith. I'll get
some sleep and redouble my efforts tomorrow!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
任務でヤシロ砦に向かうことになったが、
これまた遠い所にあるな……
text.official_en:
My duties require me to travel to Yashiro Fort,
but it's so far from here.

text.jp:
現地の総督や軍が協力的かどうかも問題だ。
こちらの指示に従ってくれれば良いのだが。
text.official_en:
There's some concern whether the local viceroy and
military will cooperate. Fingers crossed...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
クレール神殿の参拝者がすごく増えました。
美人の祭司がお目当てなのでしょう。
text.official_en:
Credna's temple has been steadily drawing in
worshippers. It must be that beautiful lead priest.
text.real_en:
Claire's temple has been steadily drawing in
worshippers. It must be that beautiful lead priest.

text.jp:
不敬ですわ、まったく！
全員追い返してやりましょうか！
text.official_en:
They're making a mockery of the faith! The temple
ought to turn them all away!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
そろそろ次の所に商売に行くか。
護衛の傭兵もまた雇い直さないとな。
text.official_en:
I wonder if it's time to move on... I'd have to hire
some mercenaries to escort me, though.

text.jp:
前に失敗したから、今度はちゃんと見極めよう。
まあ、結局のところ相性なんだけどさ。
text.official_en:
I've been burned before, so this time I'll properly vet
them. A treacherous bodyguard is worse than none.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
毎日毎日酒場通い。いい気分だわー。
自分で料理なんてしたくもないしね。
text.official_en:
I go to the tavern every day. It's wonderful not to
have to cook for myself!

text.jp:
これも大剣闘祭の賭けで、一発当てたおかげ！
あのクランには感謝しないと！
text.official_en:
I owe it all to winning big on a bet I placed at the
Heroic Games. I should thank that clan...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
いつになったら槌を握らせてくれるのかしら……
もう何年も手伝いばっかりしてるのよ。
text.official_en:
I've been putting in my time helping out for years.
So when will he let me take up the hammer?

text.jp:
父さんのやり方だって生まれた時から見てるのに
『まだ見習い未満だ』とかなんとか！
text.official_en:
I've been watching how Dad does it since I was born,
but he still says, "You've got a lot to learn!"

text.jp:
あたしが鉄を叩けば、
あっという間にいい剣が作れるっての！
text.official_en:
If I could just get some experience at the anvil,
I could be crafting quality swords in no time!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ヴァンダル商会の筆頭総支配人って、
フェロニア郡の出身なんだって？
text.official_en:
Do you think it's true the chief executive of the
Vandahl Trading Company is from Feronia?

text.jp:
俺と同郷じゃないか。金持ちは住む世界が違うって
思ってたけど、親近感が湧いてきたぜ。
text.official_en:
That's where I'm from! I never imagined I might be
neighbors with someone so rich.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
湖に住む生き物の調査……
はあ、なぜ私がそのようなことを……
text.official_en:
Why are they making me survey the creatures living
in the lake?

text.jp:
まずは聞き込みをしよう。つまらない報告を
神位にするわけにもいかんからな。
text.official_en:
I'll ask the locals for information. Maybe I can put
together a decent report without dirtying my hands.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
サラミスの船ってすごいよなあ……
どうやって造ったかとか教えてくれないかな……
text.official_en:
That Saraminian ship is incredible. I wonder if they'd
share the secrets of how it was built.

text.jp:
でも、あんなおっかなそうな連中に聞くなんて
とてもできそうにないな。
text.official_en:
Well, even if they would, I'd have to ask first.
And they're way too scary for that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
停泊している船の近くで
遊ぶ子供を時々見るんですよね。
text.official_en:
From time to time, I see children playing around
the moored ships.

text.jp:
荷物が落ちてきたり、縄に巻き込まれでもしたら、
どうするつもりなんでしょう。
text.official_en:
What will they do if some of that cargo falls on them,
or they get tangled up in the lines?

text.jp:
今度見かけたら、
ガツンと叱ってやらないといけませんね。
text.official_en:
I'll have to give them a good telling-off the next time
I see them at the docks.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
仕入れた品が全部売れた！
こいつは気分がいいね！
text.official_en:
I managed to completely sell out of my inventory!
And it feels amazing.

text.jp:
頑張った部下たちを労ってやらないと。
今夜は酒宴でも開いてやるか。
text.official_en:
My employees did a lot of the work. Maybe I'll take
them all to dinner in celebration.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
伝説の吟遊詩人バッハール。
願わくばもう一度、彼の語りを聴きたいものね。
text.official_en:
I hope to hear the tale of the legendary bard
Bakhar again.

text.jp:
少女だった頃とはまた違う気持ちで、
素敵な物語を楽しむことができそうだもの。
text.official_en:
It's a wonderful story, and I think I'd have a new
appreciation for it now that I'm older.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
本は素晴らしい知識と教養の泉だ。
だが、最も素晴らしいのは……
text.official_en:
Books are a fabulous source of knowledge, and that's
not all there is to recommend them.

text.jp:
いざとなったら資産になるところだな。
部屋一面にあるのだ、さぞや良い値がつくぞ。
text.official_en:
They are also an asset in lean times. I keep a room
full of them, as they're bound to fetch high prices.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
帝都の劇場に立ち、拍手喝采をこの身に受ける。
いやはや、実に光栄だね。
text.official_en:
To stand upon the stage of the theater in the capital
and hear the applause ring out is a high honor.

text.jp:
稀代の劇作家、ダンテの戯曲を
演じられるとなれば猶更だ。
text.official_en:
But not so high as securing a role in a play by the
matchless playwright Dante...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
大剣闘祭に出場してた
変な猫の仮面をつけた神官なんだけど
text.official_en:
Everyone's talking about the priest fighting in the
Heroic Games while wearing a strange cat mask.

text.jp:
試合中に仮面が壊れて、
でてきた素顔を見ちゃったのよ。
text.official_en:
Well, her face was revealed after her mask was
shattered during a match!

text.jp:
それがもう、本当に綺麗な顔でさ……
いやもう、たまげたのなんの。
text.official_en:
Even a small glimpse of her beauty was enough to
leave some people thunderstruck.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝が１００隻もの戦艦を造らせたって
伝説があるんだけど。
text.official_en:
I heard a story that Dagda the Great had a hundred
warships built.

text.jp:
もしかすると、ダナン海を騒がしていた
海賊王との激突に備えるためだった、とかかな。
text.official_en:
Must've been getting ready to fight the Pirate King
over who got to be boss in the Danann Sea.

text.jp:
多分そうだよ。
なぜって、時代もだいたい一致するし。
text.official_en:
How come? Well...both those things happened
around the same time, I think.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
いやあ、猫の仮面の神官さん、とんでもない
美人じゃないか。たまげたなあ。
text.official_en:
Is it true that the priest with the cat mask is
astoundingly beautiful?

text.jp:
若い男どもは、美人の神官さんを見ようと
クレール神殿に押しかけてるって話だよ。
text.official_en:
I've heard that young men are flocking to Credna's
temple to get a look at her.
text.real_en:
I've heard that young men are flocking to Claire's
temple to get a look at her.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダグザの地の一部地域では、ハクア様と
呼ばれる存在が密かに信仰されていると聞く。
text.official_en:
In certain parts of Dagda, a being called Pallraven
is being worshipped in secret.

text.jp:
なんでも、ハクア様はダグザ神族よりも古い神で、
この地でもともと信仰されてきていたものだと。
text.official_en:
This Pallraven is supposedly older than the Dagdan
pantheon—it was the original faith of this land.

text.jp:
その姿は白い鴉なんだそうだが、そんなものを
信仰するなんて、神殿に対し不敬じゃないのかな。
text.official_en:
It supposedly took the form of a white raven. But
isn't belief in such things heresy against the temples?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
世が太平だと
終末思想ってのが流行るみたいだね。
text.official_en:
It's when everything is at peace that fears of the
end of the world flourish.

text.jp:
皆不安なのさ。この平穏が
一体いつまで続くかってことが。
text.official_en:
Peace makes us uneasy. We start to wonder just how
long it can hold.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
これは本当にあるかどうかも
分からねえ話なんだが……
text.official_en:
I don't really know if this story is true or not, so take
it with a grain of salt.

text.jp:
ダグザの地には、そいつに出会ったら
破滅するってヤバイ馬車が走ってるんだ。
text.official_en:
But there's a deadly carriage traveling around Dagda.
Anyone who gets too close is cut down.

text.jp:
そいつは、真っ黒で、巨大で、
棘だらけの巨大な奴で……
text.official_en:
The thing is colossal, jet black, and covered in
sharp spikes.

text.jp:
街道を我が物顔で走って、
前を塞いだものは全部弾き飛ばしちまうらしい。
text.official_en:
It drives like it owns the roads, knocking aside
anything that blocks its path.

text.jp:
出くわした乗合馬車が跳ね飛ばされて
崖下に落とされただの、ろくな話がねえ。
text.official_en:
One story even says that it forced another carriage
off a cliff. What a way to meet one's end!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダナン海ってのは、アンガスの門と
ブランの門というふたつの難所によって、
text.official_en:
There are two difficult points in the Danann Sea:
Aonghas Strait and Bran Narrows.

text.jp:
外海への出口を塞がれているらしい。
どんな船でも突破することが不可能なんだと。
text.official_en:
Between them, they block passage to the seas
beyond. No ship has yet broken through.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
白髪鬼の戦いぶり……苛立っているというか、
荒々しさが増してきているような気がする。
text.official_en:
The White-Maned Demon fights as if possessed.
He grows more untamed with every battle.

text.jp:
どこか具合でも悪いのではなかろうな。
少し心配だ。
text.official_en: I worry he might be unwell...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
兵種によって、それぞれ扱える武器が
異なっていることには気づいているか？
text.official_en:
Have you noticed that the weapons you can use
change depending on your class?

text.jp:
実はそれぞれの兵種で使える武器には、
得意なものと苦手なものがあるのだ。
text.official_en:
Each class has some weapons they specialize in,
and others they're less suited to.

text.jp:
得意な武器を使っていれば、
技能の成長が早いなどの恩恵が得られる。
text.official_en:
Use a favored weapon and you can be sure your skill
with it will rapidly increase.

text.jp:
逆に苦手な武器を無理に使っていると、
あまり良い結果が得られなかったりする。
text.official_en:
Though if you are bent on using a weapon you're less
proficient with, the results may be disappointing.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ドレイクの財宝は、同じ種類のものが
互いに呼び合うという噂がある。
text.official_en:
There's a theory that Drake's treasures actually call
out to their own kind.

text.jp:
だとすると、この大剣闘祭にも財宝を持っている
戦士たちが集まってきてるのかもしれないな。
text.official_en:
If it's true, we may well be hosting many such
wielders of the treasures at the Heroic Games.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
「ダグザの焔将」の中でも
特に高名な人物を上げるとすれば……
text.official_en:
There are a few Flame Lords of Dagda who are
particularly well-known.

text.jp:
８７５年に起こった
ブリギットの海戦を制した「不沈のギスコ」。
text.official_en:
There was Unsinkable Gisco, who claimed victory
at sea against Brigid in the year 875.

text.jp:
８８１年のダマスカルの８月事件の
指揮をとり、恐れられた「雪崩のガイウス」。
text.official_en:
Caius the Avalanche, who took command at the
Cleansing of Damascar in the year 881.

text.jp:
そして、忘れてはならないのが１０４３年の
神前試合で素晴らしい戦いを見せた――
text.official_en:
And how can we forget the mighty combatants in the
Duel for the Gods in the year 1043?

text.jp:
勇者ブレザとハンノ王も、ともに「激塵のブレザ」、
「赤光のハンノ」の二つ名を与えられました。
text.official_en:
The champion Breza and King Hanno, who received
the titles Dust-Rage Breza and Red-Ray Hanno.

text.jp:
ただ……こちらの焔将としての二つ名は、
残念なことに、あまり一般に広まっておりません。
text.official_en:
Although in that case, their Flame Lord titles are
sadly not very widely known today.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
アウロラ様は、星と航海の知識を
授けてくださる神位でございます。
text.official_en:
Aurora's domain is knowledge of the sea and
voyages upon it.

text.jp:
このため、長い旅を続ける旅人や
海に関わる者が多く訪れます。
text.official_en:
That's why sailors and travelers embarking on long
voyages often visit her temple before departing.

text.jp:
そういえば、先日もサラミスの王族が
訪問しましたが、謁見は叶いませんでした。
text.official_en:
There's talk of the queen of Saramis visiting recently.
The story going around is no audience was granted.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
南西の地域に領土を構えるブレザラント王国は
勇者ブレザによって建国された国だ。
text.official_en:
The kingdom of Brezarant in the southwest was
founded by the champion Breza.

text.jp:
勇者ブレザといえば、
軍神マーズと人間の間に産まれた半神で、
text.official_en:
Breza was a demigod born of Mars, the Bringer of
War, and a human.

text.jp:
時のアラゴ王ハンノと大闘技場で
死闘を演じた神前試合が有名だよね。
text.official_en:
He fought a storied match in the arena against King
Hanno of Arago, known as the Duel for the Gods.

text.jp:
そのときの功績によって、自分の国を
建国することを認められたんだ。
text.official_en:
His feats in that battle won him recognition for his
budding nation.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神殿が保管しているアークの中でも、
特に重要なものが「至高のアーク」です。
text.official_en:
Among the Arcs stored in the temples, the Supreme
Arcs are especially noteworthy.

text.jp:
これらは皆、とび抜けた力を持っており、
神位の名を冠している特別な品です。
text.official_en:
These are artifacts of uncanny power, usually bearing
the name of one of the divines.

text.jp:
神位たちから特別に認められると、
貸し与えられることがあると言われています。
text.official_en:
On occasion, some people receive special permission
from the gods to wield them.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神と人間の間にできた子は、
神と同じくその身に血印を宿し、
text.official_en:
Children born from the union of a god and a human
have bloodmarks just like the gods.

text.jp:
さらに、普通の人間よりも強い力を持ち、
寿命も長いと言われています。
text.official_en:
They're also said to be stronger than ordinary men,
with longer lifespans to boot.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
まっとうに生きてる奴なら
こんなところに用事はないはずだ。
text.official_en: Honest folk got no business here.

text.jp:
……とっとと消えろ。
まずい事になる前にな。
text.official_en: So disappear before someone disappears you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダグザ神殿にまつわる
こんな言い伝えを知ってるかい？
text.official_en:
There's a commonly held belief about
Dagda's temple.

text.jp:
なんでも、あの神殿の前で交わした約束は、
未来永劫にわたって力を持つんだとさ。
text.official_en:
They say vows sworn before that temple have a
power that endures for eternity.

text.jp:
それで、ダグシオンの若い男女達の間では
あそこで愛を囁くのが流行ってるのさ。
text.official_en:
For that reason, young men and women of Dagsion
often choose that spot to profess their love.

text.jp:
ただ、もしも神官に見つかったら
つまみ出されちまうぜ。
text.official_en:
Though if the priests catch them at it, they'll be
chased off.
